'''Balfam Sen''' was a [[Chevin/Legends|Chevin]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a High Inquisitor of the [[Chevin Conglomerate]] of [[Vinsoth/Legends|Vinsoth]] near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was involved with the planning of the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]], a galaxy-wide [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] hunt to find unique and rare items that was secretly part of a plot to appeal to the returning [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] fleet.

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Grand Acquisitions Race is competitive commerce which enriches your citizens. The SIS has no grounds to interfere.|Balfam Sen speaking to SIS agent [[Reeho]] in the [[Chevin (language)|Chevin language]]|translated=1|<ref name="TOR" />}}
In [[3639 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|1.3}}</ref> Balfam Sen and two other Chevin High Inquisitors met in secret on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] after announcing the [[Grand Acquisitions Race]] to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Eventually, their secret meeting was discovered as part of investigations by both the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] and the Sith Empire. Agent [[Reeho]] of the SIS appeared in a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] to talk to Sen and the other High Inquisitors, but Sen told Reeho that he had no grounds to interfere with the Grand Acquisitions Race since it would enrich the citizens of the Republic. Reeho was not fooled by the Chevin's deception, and informed Sen that he would be seeing him later.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balfam Sen first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of the "The Great Acquisitions Race" World Event.<ref name="TOR" />
